mapper.sql: ics02_manager_id AS manager_id, ics02_manager_group_nm AS manager_group_name, ics02_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(ics02_person_id) AS person_name, ics02_note AS note, COALESCE(ics02_default_yn, 'false') AS default_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ics02_manager WHERE ics02_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY COALESCE(ics02_default_yn, 'false') DESC
SELECT FROM ics02_manager WHERE ics02_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(ics02_default_yn, 'false') LIKE 'true' LIMIT 1

SELECT ics04_share_id AS share_id, ics04_share_cd AS share_code, f_cdnm('ShareCode', ics04_share_cd, ics04_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS share_name, ics04_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(ics04_person_id) AS person_name, ics04_org_id AS org_id, f_org_nm(ics04_org_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_name, ics04_company_id AS company_id FROM ics04_share a WHERE ics04_manager_id = #{managerId} AND ics04_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY ics04_share_cd, ics04_org_id
